lensFocus.security: Presigned URLs, signatures, X-Amz-* query strings, Authorization headers and credentials never appear in errors, logs, test failure output, fixtures or committed files; provider XML/error bodies are bounded and sanitized (no URL echo). Signed headers cannot be dropped or altered without breaking the signature; the checksum header is never query-hoisted; Content-Length is exact; create-only If-None-Match is signed. Endpoint validation allows only https with no userinfo/path/query/fragment and the exact R2 host shape in production; no redirect is ever followed; keys derive only from persisted grant records with class/namespace validation (no request-supplied keys, foreign namespaces or path tricks). The hub never GETs object bodies. Blob IDs use crypto/rand and confer no authority. No real network: every S3 request in tests targets an httptest server with fake credentials. No AWS SDK or new module; blobwire stays stdlib-only and the CLI SQLite-free.
lensFocus.tests: Signer tests use a literal known vector (canonical request, string-to-sign, signature) not recomputed with production code, plus escaping (space, plus, slash), query sorting, every required signed header missing/changed, TTL edges (exactly 600 s, floor near a finite deadline, refusal below 1 s, PUT 300 s) and secret-free errors. TestDownloadGrantHasDistinctDeadlines and TestR2MigrationKeepsDiskPins exist as the plan states; keep wire tests prove null object deadlines survive serialization while capability deadlines stay finite; disk-vs-R2 serialization both pinned. Fake-S3 tests cover matching/mismatched provider SHA, size, type and metadata, verification false until completion, foreign namespace, missing object, malicious error bodies, class/prefix mismatch, method/path/header tampering, bounded metadata, and a Download after an earlier URL's deadline succeeding without it; fake counters prove only HEAD/DELETE from the hub. Injected clocks only, no sleeps, no outbound network. Migration tests find the R2 migration by its _r2_blobs.sql suffix. Existing disk blob tests pass unchanged.

Interfaces exactly: `R2Objects.Head(ctx, key) (ObjectProof, error)`, `Delete(ctx, key) error`, `Download(ctx, key, now, objectExpiry) (blobwire.Request, error)` with objectExpiry optional (nil for keep; record the exact Go type). ObjectProof carries length, ETag, stored metadata, optional provider checksum and the checksum profile.

Keys come only from persisted grant records: validate the class-first shape `attachments/v1/exp/<1h|6h|12h|1d|7d|30d>/<hub_namespace>/<blob_id>` or `attachments/v1/keep/<hub_namespace>/<blob_id>`; reject foreign namespaces, class/prefix mismatches and anything request-derived.

HEAD and DELETE are hub-private SigV4 requests through an injected http.Client/RoundTripper whose CheckRedirect refuses every redirect. Bound response headers, XML and error bodies (LimitReader). The hub never GETs object bodies: no verification GET, no full-body buffering or hashing. Fake-S3 counters must prove only HEAD/DELETE reached the fake from the hub.

Completion evidence per Task 0: prefer the provider-returned SHA-256 checksum on HEAD; otherwise immutable existence plus matching SIGNED checksum metadata, valid only because the spike proved R2 enforces the signed checksum. Mismatched SHA, size, type, disposition or cache policy rejects; verification stays false until a match. If evidence cannot bind the enforced checksum to the immutable key, fail closed and report it.

Errors are sanitized and typed: map provider XML codes to errors without URLs, query strings, signatures, raw XML or Authorization. Test a malicious provider error body containing a URL and a credential-looking string.

Download mints a fresh presign on every call from the injected now: floor(min(600s, remaining)) for finite objects, 600 s for keep with a null object deadline, refusal under 1 s. No URL stored or cached; a call after an earlier URL's deadline succeeds without it.
Authorization and the shared 30/60 s mint limiter belong to Task 4's hub wrapper (BlobDownload), not this adapter; do not add them here.

Interfaces exactly: `(*Transfers).Reserve(ctx, uploader, idem string, in blobwire.UploadRequest) (blobwire.UploadGrant, error)`, `Complete(ctx, uploader, blobID string) (blobwire.Ref, error)`, `State(ctx, blobID string) (blobwire.State, error)`, `Tick(ctx) error`, `PurgeHash(ctx, sha string) error`, `PutDurable(ctx, tx *sql.Tx, purpose, sha, media string, data []byte) error` (hub spill/source only).

One reservation transaction reads `preferences.LoadSnapshot(ctx, tx)` then `snapshot.Get("blobs.expiry")`, reserves against the issue day's nonrefundable daily quota AND the hub storage quota (`storage_reserved_bytes + retained_bytes + new_size <= limit`), allocates blob_id/class/key and snapshots value/source/revision. Failed preference reads fail the grant closed. Preference changes affect new grants only; idempotent replays return the original snapshot and deadlines.

Quota CAS: reserved->accepted moves once; abandoned/failed reservations are never refunded that day; issue day survives midnight/restart; storage charge releases only after deletion is confirmed after upload_deadline+60 s; restart reconciliation never double-counts.
